searchText: can run both 5.0 and 5.1 on the same port? In theory yes, but your `5.0` application will need to be robust enough to handle all the datagrams it will receive for the 5.1 protocol which I believe can be done reliably but I haven't gotten to a point where I'm trying that out yet. the v5.1 wire format was designed to make the datagram packets resistance to DPI so that they can't easily be filtered out by over-zealous network admins. The implication here is that v5 packets can be inspected and identified at the networking level
